title: 蒼穹の巡礼と、綴られぬ星辰の叙事詩
author: 竜胆 アルト

en.title: Pilgrimage of the Azure Firmament and the Unwritten Epic of the Stars
en.premise: In the Age of Falling Stars, when stars rain from the heavens and the world slides toward an eternal winter, a fallen noble youth—once a cartographer of the star maps—sets out to complete the forbidden "True Star Map" alongside a mute holy knight. Guiding them is a legendary migratory bird that circles the heavens only once every few millennia, following the celestial guidance. Their journey weaves together fragments of lost myths to break the chains of destiny.

zh.title: 苍穹的巡礼与未书写星辰的叙事诗
zh.premise: 星辰从天而坠，世界步入永恒的冬季——这就是“星坠时代”。曾是星图编纂者的没落贵族青年，为了完成被视为禁忌的“真星图”，与失去语言的圣骑士踏上前往世界尽头的旅程。指引他们的是每千年才会一次、遵循天之指引而迁徙的传说之鸟。他们将拼凑失落的神话碎片，斩断名为“命运”的枷锁。
